fullPassage: Despite the difference between the past and the future, between what has happened and what is to come, it can be suggested, that our sense of the past has always been influenced by our view of the future. Revolutionaries have always looked to the past to frame their future cause, as is amply illustrated by examples from nationalism to communism. The future has often been seen as variously a recovery of a lost time, as a replication of what is established, or as a model bequeathed by a heroic age long gone. The writing of history is based on understanding or explaining future outcomes that were not known to contemporaries, since the historian has the benefit of hindsight and the past is nothing more than the accumulation of futures that are now our past. So, rather than see the hand of the past always shaping the future, perhaps it can be seen in reverse, with the past — in the sense of our understanding of it — being shaped by our orientation to the future.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 과거에 대한 우리의 인식은 미래관에 의해 영향을 받아왔다(influenced). 혁명가(Revolutionaries)들은 미래의 대의를 구성(frame)하기 위해 과거를 돌아보았다.

❌ ④ abandon(포기하다): frame의 반의어
det.tip: influenced(영향받은) ↔ unaffected, frame(구성하다) ↔ abandon(포기하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 미래는 잃어버린 시간의 회복(recovery), 확립된 것의 복제(replication), 혹은 영웅 시대가 물려준(bequeathed) 모델로 보여져 왔다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ recovery — replication — bequeathed: 원문과 일치
❌ ① loss(상실): recovery의 반의어
❌ ② destruction(파괴): replication의 반의어
❌ ④ stolen(도둑맞은): bequeathed의 반의어
det.tip: recovery(회복) ↔ loss, replication(복제) ↔ destruction, bequeath(물려주다) ↔ steal

questions.passage: Revolutionaries have always looked to the past to frame their future cause, as is amply illustrated by examples from nationalism to communism. The future has often been seen as variously a recovery of a lost time, as a replication of what is established, or as a model bequeathed by a heroic age long gone. The historian has the benefit of (A)[hindsight / foresight]. The past is nothing more than the (B)[accumulation / depletion] of futures. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 역사가는 사후판단(hindsight)의 이점을 갖는다. 과거는 미래의 축적(accumulation)일 뿐이다. 과거에 대한 이해는 미래를 향한 지향(orientation)에 의해 형성된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ hindsight — accumulation — orientation: 원문과 일치
❌ ① foresight(선견지명): hindsight의 반의어
❌ ② depletion(고갈): accumulation의 반의어
❌ ③ indifference(무관심): orientation의 반의어
det.tip: hindsight(사후판단) ↔ foresight(선견), accumulation(축적) ↔ depletion(고갈)

✅ ① influenced: 원문 일치
✅ ② frame: 원문 일치

❌ ④ foresight: 원문은 hindsight — 반의어
det.tip: hindsight(사후판단) ↔ foresight(선견지명). 역사가 = 결과를 이미 앎

det.tip: accumulate(축적하다, 동사) → accumulation(축적, 명사)

questions.passage: Revolutionaries have always looked to the past to frame their future cause, as is amply illustrated by examples from nationalism to communism. The future has often been seen as variously a recovery of a lost time, as a replication of what is established, or as a model bequeathed by a heroic age long gone. The writing of history is based on understanding or explaining future outcomes that were not known to contemporaries, since the historian has the benefit of __________. So, rather than see the hand of the past always shaping the future, perhaps it can be seen in reverse, with the past — in the sense of our understanding of it — being shaped by our orientation to the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 역사가는 사후판단(hindsight)의 이점을 갖는다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ hindsight(사후판단): 역사가는 결과를 이미 알고 있음
❌ ① ignorance(무지): 반대
❌ ② prediction(예측): 역사가는 예측이 아닌 사후 분석
❌ ③ coincidence(우연): 문맥과 다름
det.tip: benefit of hindsight = 사후판단의 이점. 역사가는 이미 결과를 앎

questions.passage: The future has often been seen as variously a recovery of a lost time, as a replication of what is established, or as a model bequeathed by a heroic age long gone. The writing of history is based on understanding or explaining future outcomes that were not known to contemporaries, since the historian has the benefit of hindsight and the past is nothing more than the accumulation of futures that are now our past. Rather than see the hand of the past always shaping the future, perhaps it can be seen in __________, with the past being shaped by our orientation to the future.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과거가 미래를 형성하는 것이 아니라 역방향(reverse)으로, 미래 지향이 과거 이해를 형성한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reverse(역방향): 인과관계의 방향 전환
❌ ② parallel(평행): 같은 방향
❌ ③ isolation(고립): 문맥과 다름
❌ ④ sequence(순서): 방향 전환의 의미 없음
det.tip: in reverse = 역방향으로. 과거→미래가 아니라 미래→과거
